Name: AnimeSkimpy Caroline CSHCompat
Author: SyouKKi
Description:
[b][size=4]Mod Introduction[/size][/b]
This is a compatibility patch for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16220]Childhood Sweetheart Caroline (Overhaul)[/url], which integrates the portrait resources from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32397]OO's Anime Style Skimpy Portraits[/url].
Uses anime skimpy style portrait images of Caroline from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32397]OO's Anime Style Skimpy Portraits[/url].
Keeps the original walking sprites of Caroline from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16220]Childhood Sweetheart Caroline (Overhaul)[/url].
Perfectly solves the texture conflict between these two popular mods, allowing you to use both sets of character assets at the same time.

[b][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/b]
1.Download and install the original two mods below.
2.Put this compatibility mod folder into your Mods folder.
3.Launch the game via SMAPI to take effect.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16220]Childhood Sweetheart Caroline (Overhaul)[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32397]OO's Anime Style Skimpy Portraits[/url]

[b][size=4]Credits[/size][/b]
All portrait textures belong to the  author of  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32397]OO's Anime Style Skimpy Portraits[/url].
All character walking sprites belong to the author of  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16220]Childhood Sweetheart Caroline (Overhaul)[/url].
This is just a simple asset integration compatibility patch, no original resources are created.

[b][size=4]Notes[/size][/b]
This mod is only a compatibility integration. Please download and endorse the two original mods to support their authors.
Do not re-upload this mod without permission from both original authors.
